zh-CN.title: 新增插件更新检查与更新历史

sections.title: 新增
items: 设置页显示当前版本，支持手动检查并直接安装新版本
发现新版本时在快速命令抽屉左上角显示更新入口
支持每天、每7天或从不自动检查更新，并可忽略指定版本提醒
新增中英文更新说明与完整更新历史，可按版本展开查看

zh-CN.notice: 更新安装完成后需要重启 Tabby 才会生效。

en.title: Plugin update checks and update history

sections.title: Added
items: Show the current version in settings, with manual checks and direct installation
Show an update shortcut at the top-left of the Quick Commands drawer when a new version is available
Check every day, every 7 days, or never, with an option to dismiss a specific version
Provide localized release notes and a complete version-by-version update history

en.notice: Restart Tabby after installation to apply the update.
